verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party sandbox at its developer docs page 'Test in Sandbox' (devtools/sandbox/overview), so it ships the core capability. However, the pack holds only that page title, so it does not show how the sandbox is separated from production data or what it covers. missing for 10: documented isolation from production data and accounts, details of sandbox credentials and endpoints, scope of APIs testable in sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
